title: A ternary-dielectric dual-domain triboelectric nanogenerator for high charge density and tail-charge suppression
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE07296D, Paper
Sihang Gao, Yuqi Sun, Lingjiang Long, Yongqi Liu, Jiyu Wang
Ternary-dielectric dual-domain TENG enables unified charge generation, tail-charge suppression, and residual-charge reutilization via synergistic corona discharge, volumetric charge migration, and dielectric polarization discharge.
